territory: Contrarian vision/ML bets: simpler-is-better, anti-scaling, anti-foundation-model, revive-old-methods, with falsifiable claims. Academic ML only.
schema_notes: Each JSONL line carries the parent-mandated fields in order (candidate_id, territory, title, one_line_idea, cluster, problem, core_hypothesis, core_claim, method_sketch, falsifiable_prediction, why_important, why_possibly_novel, novelty_hook, minimal_falsification_experiment, main_risk, kill_risk, community_default_belief, why_it_might_be_wrong, fastest_falsifying_experiment, evidence_label). Following the convention of earlier Wave A shards (genA-11), alias fields mirror their counterparts: core_claim mirrors core_hypothesis, minimal_falsification_experiment mirrors method_sketch, novelty_hook mirrors why_possibly_novel, kill_risk mirrors main_risk. Every candidate states the community default belief, why it might be wrong, and a cheapest/fastest falsifying experiment, per the contrarian-territory mandate.

compliance.forbid_fiction: No fabricated papers, citations, benchmark numbers, dataset facts, or experimental results; all quantitative statements are phrased as falsifiable predictions under HYPOTHESIS or MODEL SPECULATION labels, and datasets/models are referenced generically as proposed experiment subjects.
compliance.novelty_claims: All novelty statements are hedged as possibly-novel and explicitly marked unverified; no verified novelty claimed.
compliance.protected_files: window.lock.json, research_state.json, ideas_master.jsonl untouched; no Windows directories created; no Windows numbers changed; only the two mandated files written under Windows16/_state/tasks/P1/.

unresolved_items: Novelty of all 80 candidates is unverified against the literature; Wave B dedup plus any novelty-checking stage must vet before promotion.

Intra-shard conceptual neighbors were minimized but remain for dedup review: ctrn-0009/ctrn-0016/ctrn-0057/ctrn-0064 (curation-versus-scale and curation-versus-alternatives budget exchanges), ctrn-0017/ctrn-0019/ctrn-0024/ctrn-0054 (from-scratch or in-domain training versus foundation/web transfer under domain shift), ctrn-0018/ctrn-0050 (human-hours exchange-rate designs), ctrn-0044/ctrn-0053 (weight-decay-suffices arguments in supervised and self-supervised contexts), ctrn-0073/ctrn-0079 (distillation dispensability from compute-matching and mechanism angles), ctrn-0021/ctrn-0073 (foundation-teacher and classic distillation compute-matched nulls).

Cross-territory overlap likely with genA-11 negative-results (equal-budget refutation designs generally, especially ctrn-0037, ctrn-0039, ctrn-0042, ctrn-0047, ctrn-0058, ctrn-0075), genA-07 benchmark weaknesses (eval_metric_contrarian cluster, especially ctrn-0059, ctrn-0065, ctrn-0068, ctrn-0070, ctrn-0071), genA-09 synthetic data (ctrn-0064), and genA-10 domain shift (ctrn-0020, ctrn-0024, ctrn-0069); dedup should treat these as high-collision zones.

Several candidates presuppose reproducing published-style methods locally under matched budgets (ctrn-0058, ctrn-0060, ctrn-0065, ctrn-0070, ctrn-0075, ctrn-0080); feasibility depends on public availability of the relevant implementations.

Candidates with human-subject components (ctrn-0018, ctrn-0022, ctrn-0050, ctrn-0061, ctrn-0067) require annotator recruitment and cost accounting that exceed a purely computational minimal experiment; their fastest-falsifying experiments are scoped-down single-annotator pilots.
